description: Repository-owned close-intent declaration for scientific-universe issues. Ordinary pytest validates fixture bytes only; no live GitHub API required.

dispositions.ACCEPTANCE_COMPLETE: All declared material completion gates are ACCEPTED.
dispositions.EXPLICIT_SUCCESSOR_TRANSFER: Every unresolved leaf is transferred to named successor issues with blocker/claim consequences preserved.
dispositions.SUPERSEDED: Exact superseding issue is named; never emits COMPLETE.
dispositions.PARTIAL_NO_CLOSE: Bounded implementation may merge; parent must not auto-close.

merge_message_residual: GitHub squash/rebase merge UI can still inject close keywords contrary to validated intent; post-merge reconciliation is required when platform enforcement is unavailable.
